title: ❌🛑 Do not buy this tree ❌🛑
text: ❌🛑 Do not buy this tree ❌🛑. When we received the tree the tree was supposed to be 7.5 ft but the tree would not assemble and only had maybe 10 branches on it. It was worse than Charlie Brown tree. Gloves were to ge worn to not have black sticky paint like substance stain hands and the instructions said WARNING 🛑Do not hang ornaments due to tree not able to carry the weight.  This was a nightmare.  Then when I return it.  It did take me little while like a week in a half to get the box to ups delivery station. I do not driver I a disabled and then when the package was received back the company charged $72.00 to return this huge piece of trash.  So I paid $118 and only received $47 refund.  This company is scammers. BEWARE ❌❌❌❌❌❌❌

product_metadata.title: Goplus 7.5FT Artificial Christmas Tree, 1258 Branch Tips, Christmas Tree with Premium PVC Needles and Metal Stand, Xmas Full Tree for Indoor and Outdoor Holiday Decoration, Champagne Gold
features: 【Selected Tinsel Material】This lush Christmas tree is made of environmental-friendly PVC with non-flammable and odorless tinsel film, which is safe and durable for long-term use. The electroplated craft makes the color of the tree brighter and more dazzling, bringing vitality to your living space.

【Easy to Assemble with Hinged Design】In a few simple steps, this Christmas tree with 3 sections is easy to assemble, disassemble and store. And the hinged branches will expand easier to save your time and energy. Just arrange it a little, hang the decorations, and a beautiful Christmas tree is finished.

【Unique Champagne Tree for Indoor & Outdoor Use】Breaking the traditional Christmas tree, the tinsel tree is designed with a shiny champagne color, making it eye-catching for indoor and outdoor decoration. It is ideal for Christmas, Halloween and other holiday celebration.

【Sturdy Metal Stand】Compared with other cheap plastic base, our reinforced metal stand will provide the tree with greater support and ensure good stability. Foldable X-shaped stand can keep the tree standing upright and prevent the tree from falling. And non-slip foot pads can protect the floor from scratches.

【Vivid & Dense Branches】 This Christmas tree is leafy and fluffy, highly showing a full-bodied and lush appearance. And it has no lights or no extra decorations, which allows you to use your imagination and unite your family together to decorate it. More meaningful and impressive!
